name: Specification Incompleteness
definition: The principal cannot enumerate every action and inaction in advance, so the agent's mandate is necessarily underspecified.
trigger_conditions: The action space is open ended or tool mediated
The agent operates without per-action approval
The instruction set is stated as goals rather than as permitted operations

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: bounded rationality and incomplete foresight make complete contracting over agent action impossible

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F009 Specification Incompleteness. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F009
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
